title: Tri-mode architecture should expose dynamic LoRA routing and VRAM telemetry
body: Implement dynamic LoRA adapter loading/hot-swapping for the resident model, expose live VRAM telemetry in Doctor, and add launcher/backend status hooks for coding mode.
interface: llama-server runtime can register/apply LoRA adapters, and Doctor includes VRAM/coding-session health. The tests call: `node-bot/doctor.js` exports `checkVramBudgets({ gpu, vramUsage, gamingWatch })` and `checkCodingSession(stickyCodingSession)`; the llama-server runtime has `findLoraAdapters()`, `applyLoraAdapter(name)` ("companion" or "assistant") and `getActiveLoraAdapter()`.
why: Model-routing reliability is part of the self-sufficiency shortlist.
